rationale.conceptual: The task involves running textbook DFT (Becke3LYP) and MP2 calculations with no custom derivations; the method is a standard application of well‑established functionals and basis sets, directly supported by PySCF.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires setting up three molecular structures, running geometry optimizations at two levels of theory (six independent calculations), and extracting total energies and bond lengths. This is a simple sequential workflow with straightforward I/O, easily scripted in a single script.
